item.title: Tuesday 1 PM Update, Nov 3
item.description:
The Tuesday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 3, 2026, Election Day: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Israeli officials say they were caught off guard by President Trump's plan to end U.S. military aid, and ballot-machine trouble in Georgia's Fulton County; Russia hits Ukraine's power grid in one of the war's largest attacks, Iran calls the latest U.S. response "not convincing," and Greenland's parliament approves a security pact with the U.S.; midday markets and a surprise jump in job openings; Netflix tests A.I. mood-based picks and G.T.A. Six sets its preload; OpenAI's Navier-Stokes claims and Anthropic's FlashProve; Barracuda patches critical email-gateway flaws; your X feed; heavy turnout in Derry and Rye; and an Australian police officer who gave his rare blood at all eighty-five of the country's donor centers. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday 10 AM Update, Nov 3
item.description:
The Tuesday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 3, 2026, Election Day: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; President Trump says U.S. aid to Israel ends after this year, and ballot scanners fail across New York's Westchester County; Trump tells Axios he's in no rush on Iran as Qatar sees hope for a deal, and Britain and the EU reach a draft deal to end post-Brexit food checks; stocks open mixed as chips rally and Apple slips; Disney weighs thousands of job cuts and Nvidia reportedly limits China exposure; A.I. companies back a shared training opt-out; firewall attacks chain two serious flaws; your X feed; heavy early turnout across New Hampshire; and a nine-year-old in Ohio who stopped traffic to help a stranger. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday Morning, Nov 3
item.description:
The Tuesday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 3, 2026, Election Day: Londonderry weather with the seven-day outlook; polls open in the midterms, the Supreme Court turns away the Justice Department's California ballot request, and a deadly shooting near a California beach; U.S. "defensive" strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island as Qatari mediation continues, and Ukrainian drones set a major Russian refinery on fire; Apple and Palantir slide in premarket trading, plus a correction to Monday's closing numbers; inside Apple's first earnings report under John Ternus; a report that DeepSeek will train its next model on Huawei chips; Apple spyware warnings in 99 countries and a BTCPay Server wallet-draining attack; your X feed; voting in Londonderry and a record turnout forecast; and a Florida town's send-off for a drive-thru worker after 37 years. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 4 PM Update, Nov 2
item.description:
The Monday 4 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 2, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow, Election Day; the NTSB's first briefing on the Palm Beach County jet crash and the Justice Department's emergency Supreme Court request on California mail ballots; President Trump says there's "no rush" on Iran, and a deadly Russian strike in the Zaporizhzhia region; the Dow gains while tech slips and oil plunges; Apple's first earnings with John Ternus; a safety warning in Anthropic's IPO filing; Google breaks up a botnet of more than a million TV boxes; your X feed; New Hampshire's ballot questions and polling-place watchers; and a foundation that looks for everyday heroes.
